role: Six matched familiar development weeks; option-specific acquisition versus exact archived candidate
selection: First six level8-estimate-v1 seeds in manifest order, chosen before this experiment; all retired development weeks.
changes: Enumerate the already admitted delivery options as separate single-option quotes with exact revenue/deadline/dealer windows. Preserve demand model, payment convention, admission gates and scenario economics. Separate option/deadline cost caches. Allow360alternatives to hold enumerated options; unchanged solver/time budget.
controls: Six exact archived portfolio-payments outcomes; default and single-option conformance tested against the frozen source.
analysis: Paired whole-week profit, qualification, throughput, payments/refunds, undelivered, failed visits, fines, action/runtime failures and candidate omissions. Six paired weeks, not twelve independent observations. Report descriptive uncertainty; no promotion or rank claim.
gate: Mean paired gain>=1500euros/week, all six qualifying, minimum weekly on-time>=.92, no undelivered, failed visits or fines. Passing only supports a next frozen structural experiment.
stopping: Exactly six new worlds, no retries/replacements or outcome-based tuning. Runtime failure stops new creation while active worlds retain outcomes. Original600second runtime budget.
authorization: Unranked only; no ranking, test finals, finals, deletion or forks.
